# AzureHPC Node Health Check #

## About

[AzureHPC Node Health Checks](https://github.com/Azure/azurehpc-health-checks?tab=readme-ov-file#azurehpc-node-health-check) provides an automated suite of test that targets specific Azure HPC offerings. This is an extension of [LBNL Node Health Checks](https://github.com/mej/nhc). 

## Support

For list of supported SKUs please refer to this [Supported Offerings List](https://github.com/Azure/azurehpc-health-checks?tab=readme-ov-file#setup).

## License

This project has several dependencies. Usage and distribution of this software must adhere to the [AZ NHC License](./LICENSE) as well as the dependency licenses.
Copyright/licenses for the software package dependencies can be found in directory ```/azure-nhc/LICENSE``` and software installation directories on the docker image.
